name: Checks
description: One row per model-audit check (formula ties, model-quality issues, delivery notes) — the raw check fields plus the reviewer's decision, written directly onto the same row. Status is stored directly (set by the reviewer's decision action), not recomputed

agentPrompts.label: Log a model-review finding
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-finance` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then record the issue I describe as a new check — title, summary, severity, check type, and the evidence supporting it — so the reviewer can work through it in the app.

agentPrompts.label: Approve, request changes, block, or dismiss a check
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-finance` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then record my decision on the check I name — write the decision action and my note directly onto that check's decision-action, decision-comment, and decided-at fields.

agentPrompts.label: What still needs review?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-finance` skill in this folder, then list the checks still in needs_review status, grouped by severity, with each check's summary and proposed action.
